defects.title: A row cell array rxn_set together with KO stops with an error
defects.trigger: calculateMCS(model, 10, 2, 'KO', 'R2', 'rxn_set', {'R1', 'R3'}) with IBM CPLEX installed and working
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-17, before any CPLEX call) 'Dimensions of arrays being concatenated are not consistent.' (MATLAB:catenate:dimensionMismatch) at line 139, rxn_set = [rxn_set; {KO}]; the column form and the row form without KO pass this line
defects.expected: rxn_set is documented as a cell array (validated by iscell), so a row cell array is accepted and KO is added to it

defects.title: The enumeration writes tmp.mat into the current folder
defects.trigger: any call that reaches the populate loop
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-17, stand-in Cplex class whose populate returns an empty pool) tmp.mat (mcs, mcs_time) is left in the current folder; lines 305/521 save it after every round, overwriting a file of that name
defects.expected: no undocumented file in the user's current folder

notes: CPLEX not installed. Repro (after initCobraToolbox(false); no CPLEX needed): global SOLVERS; saved = SOLVERS; model = createModel({'R1','R2','R3','R4'}, {'R1','R2','R3','R4'}, {' -> A','A <=> B','A -> B','B -> '}); model.c(4) = 1; SOLVERS.ibm_cplex.installed = 1; SOLVERS.ibm_cplex.working = 1; calculateMCS(model, 10, 2, 'KO', 'R2', 'rxn_set', {'R1', 'R3'}) % error line 139; with {'R1'; 'R3'} it reaches Cplex (line 422, 'Undefined function Cplex'); SOLVERS = saved. Quarantine scope: confined to KO combined with a row rxn_set of 2+ entries; the only src caller buildGmatrix passes rxn_set = rxns(find(DM)) (column) and no KO, so it does not reach it. Without the defect, a test would be possible here: the guard error COBRA:calculateMCS:requiresCplex (line 82) runs as is, and a stand-in Cplex handle class (Param leaves for setCplexParam, addIndicators, populate) reaches the rest; I probed only an empty-pool stand-in. Not filed: n_mcs is a soft limit (every solution of a populate round, up to 40, is added before k < n_mcs is checked).
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: line 139 concatenates a row cell rxn_set with {KO} vertically; header documents rxn_set as a cell array; writer's plain-MATLAB reproduction)

defects.title: An LPProblem without csense stops with an error
defects.trigger: LP = struct('A', sparse([1 -1 0; 0 1 -1]), 'b', [0; 0], 'c', [0; 0; 1], 'lb', zeros(3, 1), 'ub', 10 * ones(3, 1), 'osense', -1); solveCobraLPCPLEX_2018(LP)
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-17, no CPLEX needed) 'Colon operands must be real scalars.' (MATLAB:colon:operandsNotRealScalar) at line 170: nMet = size(LPProblem.A) (line 165) is [2 3]
defects.expected: csense is documented as optional; one 'E' per row of A is filled in and the LP solved

defects.title: The documented solution fields solver (every interface) and stat (ILOGsimple) are missing
defects.trigger: the LP above with LP.csense = ['E'; 'E']: solveCobraLPCPLEX_2018(LP) (TOMLAB) and solveCobraLPCPLEX_2018(LP, 0, 0, 0, [], 0, 'ILOGsimple')
defects.observed: (stand-in cplex/Cplex/cplexlp/cplexoptimset solving with gurobi) tomlab_cplex: fields full, dual, rcost, obj, nInfeas, sumInfeas, origStat, time, stat (no solver); ILOGsimple: obj, full, dual, rcost, nInfeas, sumInfeas, origStat, time (no stat, no solver); obj = 10 in both
defects.expected: OUTPUT documents .stat and .solver for every solution

notes: CPLEX/TOMLAB not installed; no src callers. Defect 1 reproduces with the trigger alone. Defect 2 confirmed with the same stand-ins as solveCobraLPCPLEXcard (see its record). Without CPLEX: default interface -> 'Undefined function cplex' (line 441); 'ILOGsimple' -> 'CPLEX not installed or licence server not up' (line 367); 'ILOGcomplex' -> by-design error of line 276 on MATLAB >= 2016, so lines 283-362 are unreachable on supported MATLAB. Not filed: the file declares function solveCobraLPCPLEX (name differs from the file; MATLAB runs it by file name); the conflict-file code (491-508) for ILOG interfaces reads a file that no ILOG call writes and needs the TOMLAB cpxBuildConflict (unconfirmable). contFunctName as text is eval'd (e.g. CPLEXParamSet).
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: without the documented-optional csense, nMet=size(LPProblem.A) is a vector and line 170 LPProblem.csense(1:nMet,1) errors; writer's plain-MATLAB reproduction)

defects.trigger: LP = struct('A', sparse([1 -1 0; 0 1 -1]), 'b', [0; 0], 'c', [0; 0; 1], 'lb', zeros(3, 1), 'ub', 10 * ones(3, 1), 'osense', -1); solveCobraLPCPLEXcard(LP)
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-17, no CPLEX needed) 'Colon operands must be real scalars.' (MATLAB:colon:operandsNotRealScalar) at line 160: nMet = size(LPProblem.A) (line 155) is [2 3]
defects.expected: csense is documented as optional; one 'E' per row of A is filled in and the LP solved

defects.title: The IBM ILOG branch returns the objective of a maximisation with the wrong sign
defects.trigger: the LP above with LP.csense = ['E'; 'E'] and IBM ILOG CPLEX (cplexlp) on the path: solveCobraLPCPLEXcard(LP)
defects.observed: (stand-in Cplex/cplexlp solving with gurobi) solution.obj = -10, full = [10;10;10], stat 1: line 331 sets obj = -c = LPProblem.c with sense 'maximize', line 362 multiplies objval by osense
defects.expected: solution.obj = LPProblem.c'*x = 10, as the TOMLAB branch returns

defects.title: theNorm 'zero' optimises the original objective in the wrong direction or reports it with the wrong sign
defects.trigger: same LP with ILOG CPLEX: solveCobraLPCPLEXcard(LP, 0, 0, 0, [], 1, 'zero'); also minNorm -1; and osense 1 with c = [0;0;-1]
defects.observed: (same stand-in) maximisation: solution.obj = 0 (minimum of v3; line 402 passes osense*c with sense 'maximize'); minimisation: solution.obj = 10 while LPProblem.c'*x = -10 (line 587)
defects.expected: first solve optimises LPProblem.c in sense osense, second keeps that optimum, obj = LPProblem.c'*x

defects.title: The cardinality solve prints the solution structure and a minimum-Euclidean-norm note
defects.observed: (same stand-in) 'solution = struct with fields: obj: 0' (line 433 lacks a semicolon) and the Euclidean-norm note of lines 806-809
defects.expected: output gated by printLevel; no Euclidean-norm note for 'zero'

notes: CPLEX/TOMLAB not installed. Defect 1 reproduces with the trigger alone (no solver call is reached). Defects 2-4 confirmed with stand-ins on a temporary path: a Cplex handle class whose solve() turns lhs<=Ax<=rhs, lb, ub, obj, Q, sense into a COBRA LP/QP solved with gurobi (objval = obj'x [+0.5x'Qx], status 1/2/3), and cplexlp/cplexqp/cplexoptimset/tomlab cplex wrappers of the same; with cplex.m (TOMLAB) the same LP gives obj 10, stat 1. Quarantine scope: defect 1 = every call whose LPProblem lacks csense (findMinCardModel passes convertToIrreversible(model), which keeps csense only if the model has it); defect 2 = osense -1 (or absent) with ILOG CPLEX; defect 3 = theNorm 'zero' with ILOG CPLEX (findMinCardModel uses 'zero' with osense 1, i.e. the line-587 form). Not filed (unconfirmable here): header says TOMLAB is preferred but the code prefers ILOG; lines 601-665 (ILOG simple) unreachable since ILOGcomplex = 1 is hard-coded; conflict file path uses '\' (200, 753) while line 734 reads the bare name from pwd (Windows only); 'two' with minNorm and osense -1 gives CPLEX a PSD Q with sense maximize. contFunctName as text is eval'd (e.g. CPLEXParamSet).
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: same missing-csense error at line 160; writer's plain-MATLAB reproduction; sign defects confirmed by the writer with stand-in Cplex functions only)
